column2: Shnyr is on the team now. Check the "Team" tab. And keep an eye on the till.
Knows every loophole. Now looks for them for good. Mostly.
Sit, I'll tell you how I once took cookies. Actually, I didn't. It was a tax.
My day is better than yesterday's me.
The square comes alive, pennants flutter over the street, and there is just one coin in the pocket.
Pastel colours, airships and signs like in an old movie.
Music, a mirror ball and colourful beams.
A world of pixels, a striped sun and chiptune music.
Planes in the sky, glass windows and the whole world close by.
Green roofs, solar panels and windmills on the hills.
Stars, rockets and a shop at the edge of the Universe.
Neon signs and drones between the skyscrapers.
The short version. Tap the shop. It's the first and most honest way to earn.
One more thing: in every era special animals visit the town. Tap to catch them. Catch them all in one go and you get a crystal.
In the "Team" tab, hire staff. Each helps in their own way, and if you tap them on the scene they might say something. Listen.
Expand the shop: new departments, new people, new story chapters.
One more thing: in every era special animals visit the town. Tap to catch them: each gives coins, and both together give a crystal.

In every era special animals show up in town from time to time: Mazok the owl, Vinyl the hedgehog, Disco the armadillo, Token the hamster, Glitchy the bug, Leaf the chameleon, Astro Axolotl and Signboard the cat. Each one moves in its own way. Tap to catch them: each gives coins, and catching both gives a crystal. At Halloween ghosts fly instead. Crystals and bonuses are won at the circus, and skins in the bonus games: Grandpa Ryo’s noodle cart in Japan and the witch’s hut at Halloween.
